doc: Stings on the battle presentation's announcements (M3-AUD-18; game/audio/sting_audio.gd, docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md 'Battle stings'). events: an EventBus.dialogue_event name -> {sfx: an sfx row; by_arg: {the event's first argument (the encounter id): row}, overriding sfx; duck: a mix.json duck reason held for duck_sec under the sting}. battle_stinger [encounter] fires as the tide line rises before the field -> battle fade; battle_bark [encounter, line_key, speaker_key] with the lead-in line; boss_intro [encounter_id, title_key] as a boss's title card shows (about 3-4 s). reduced: with reduced audio on, a row -> its version without sub-bass. Act II's creature bosses are keyed by their intro's title key (BOSS_TITLE_*, choreo.json boss_intro.by_enemy) until their encounters exist; StingAudio tries the encounter first, then the title key (M4-A2P-092). Combat's encounters now name the four creature bosses (ch10_mangrove_drowner and the rest), so they are keyed by encounter id too; the title keys stay as the fallback. The people bosses are keyed by their planned encounter ids (ch14.md, ch16.md §3). The tide line (M3-AUD-864, the encounter pass) crests with the line at 0.5 s and dips the field music (mix.json `encounter`) for the rise and hold (battle_transition.json rise_sec + hold_sec), letting go as the router fades, so the battle cue never enters ducked.
